QuestInfo.name: Kindness
QuestInfo.0: Gared tells you to release the Snow Child. There's no way the village chief could be oblivious to the backlash this will cause. He must have been moved by your determination to help the boy. \r\nYou hurry to the storeroom where the Snow Child has been locked up.
